$comment: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (imagodei Attestation entry, kind='steward-of-record'). Category A. Declares the operational steward-of-record for a doorway — the accountable person/agent for day-to-day operation. Separate from custody: custody is legal/social, stewardship is operational. Often the same agent (grandpa was both), can split (household custodies, kid stewards). The steward-of-record is who signs operate-doorway Commitments under their authority; the chain is custody -> steward -> operator commitments. Reach: commons (current steward is publicly auditable). Succession quorum membership is commons; secret material is intimate.
title: StewardOfRecordAttestationMetadata
description: Per-subtype metadata for attestation:steward-of-record. Asserts the signing agent is the operational steward-of-record for the named doorway, serving under the named custody attestation. Steward authority is what activates operate-doorway Commitments — operators serve under the steward, the steward serves under custody. Steward transfer is independent of custody transfer (steward can be replaced without changing custody).

doorwayId.description: DoorwayRegistration.id this stewardship covers. Must match the doorwayId of the referenced custody attestation.

stewardAgent.description: Agent public key serving as steward-of-record. May be the same agent as the custodian (collapsed roles) or distinct (delegated stewardship).

custodyAttestationHash.description: ActionHash of the active HardwareCustodyAttestation this stewardship operates under. The auth chain requires this attestation to still be current (not superseded) for the stewardship to be valid.

successionQuorum.description: M-of-N quorum authorized to attest a stewardship transfer. May or may not overlap with the custody quorum. Reuses Recovery Phase 2 primitives.

responsibilities.description: Declared operational responsibilities this steward accepts. Free-form for now; future versions may constrain to an enum aligned with admin endpoint categories (federation, hosted-users, projection, etc.).

predecessorAttestationHash.description: Prior StewardOfRecordAttestation this supersedes. Null on genesis.
